name: Non-Wilderness scorpions
accessNote: Non-Wilderness scorpions for Turael, Spria, and Mazchna tasks: the Al Kharid mine, the Dwarven Mine, and Karamja hold level 14 scorpions, while King scorpions (level 32) are in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and Keldagrim scorpion mine. The Slayer task/Scorpions table (pageid 297991) lists the Al Kharid Mine as cannonable and safespottable; the Dwarven Mine alternative bans cannons (prohibited area).
